design_system.name: Nusagara document system
design_system.premise: The state runs on paperwork, so the interface is paperwork.
design_system.shape: border-radius 0 everywhere; hard offset shadows, no blur
design_system.one_sheet: title / pause / death / victory are FORM 404-B with different stamps

typography.origin: CraftPix Tiny Pixel Hero pack's Planes_ValMore.ttf
typography.reason: the original had no apostrophe, so English contractions rendered as gaps
typography.rule: type only at multiples of 14.7px or the pixel font smears

responsive.rule: transform:scale() shrinks pixels, NOT the layout box
responsive.consequence: scaled small print still reserves full width; compensate with width:135.1% + overflow-wrap, or negative margin, or it shoves the layout off the page
responsive.phone_hud: the utility strip gets its own grid row; #clockbar is a grid item (it used to be absolute and sat on the dialogue); the gamepad band is reserved with padding-bottom on #hud, not by hiding panels

character_select.name: the personnel deck
character_select.shape: CSS 3D coverflow of the characters themselves, flat 2D canvases, one WebGL context in the whole page
character_select.featured_card: live THREE.WebGLRenderer plane, lit, running the hero's idle strip
input: click the centre card to start
character_select.spread: derived from the measured track width, not a breakpoint; .deck clips as a backstop
character_select.fallback: webglcontextlost or a refused context leaves the flat 2D avatar in place
character_select.scale: one integer magnification for every hero (uniform pixel size, honest heights); cards anchored to the floor and scaled about their feet so the line-up stands on one line

design_system.title_screen: opaque paper sheet; the game does NOT render behind it (see CLAUDE.md V27)

world.reroute: Act IV (biomes 15-19): relay/tide/margin/field/annex, finale at Counter Nine Annex
world.collector_route_buying: biomes 4-7 marked up x1.5, freed per-region with 3 RG counter-fee

sprite_law.collider_origin: o.y is the BOTTOM of the box
sprite_law.hero_anchor: fitHeroToWorld() measures opaque bounds -> sc, yOff, hw, h
sprite_law.monster_anchor: monsterFoot() measures the lowest opaque pixel of cell 0
sprite_law.critical: the offset must be DERIVED from the height actually rendered. e.sc is the single source of truth for monster size; anchorFeet(e) recomputes yOff after any change to it. A plane scales about its centre, so a frozen offset buries the feet by height*(sc-1)/2.
sprite_law.scale_chain: TIER_SCALE up to 1.22, miniboss x1.45, so 1.77 max

scale_of_the_world.principle: a person is the measuring stick; nothing is sized by cell padding
scale_of_the_world.mechanism: MONSTERS[sp].hgt normalises drawn height via monsterBounds()
scale_of_the_world.was: heroes 2.35, zombie/soldier 1.56 — humans were the smallest things in the game
